author: JUBBINATOR
body:
Ima add to this later, but I got some suggestions for y'all. Well, 1 atm
- Have a roadmap w/updates so the community knows where y'all is headed and people can't complain no more about y'all not doing nothing. If you got all that stuff listed, instead of doing everything behind the scenes, I think a lot more people'd be placated. Not saying you needa say everything, like cos I know y'all got some surprises and secret stuff planned that we ain't supposed to know about, but put some stuff there, maybe some screenshots or something?
